name: Tari DailyGrad
description: Adds dailygrad_digest (read the DailyGrad digest), dailygrad_run (ask the host runner for a new run), dailygrad_repair (ask the host runner to complete a degraded digest as a new revision of its run, with the same stories), dailygrad_sources / dailygrad_sources_update (list and change DailyGrad's news sources through the host runner), and dailygrad_leetcode (read and switch DailyGrad's LeetCode hint preference, and complete or move on from its current LeetCode exercise, through the host runner).

timeZone.description: Installation IANA timezone, configured from TARI_TIMEZONE.
